purpose: Planning snapshot, not live task status. Gantry is authoritative for execution.

tasks.title: D1 — Draft dashboard journey PRD and reconcile RFC-008
tasks.description: Create Draft PRD-002 for the dashboard journey: saved scope -> choose next review -> read context -> respond -> confirm GitHub sync -> return to queue. Compare reviewer-first default with maintainer health-first; make the choice explicit for human review. Define request/document count units, active re-review after merge, partial/stale/loading/empty states, account-scoped recovery, compact/detached behavior, accessibility and measurable usability criteria. Inventory available Hermit API signals; do not invent assignment/personalization. Reconcile RFC-008 single-repo, embedded Settings and direct GitHub assumptions with ADR-009 and current integration code. Acceptance: linked draft PRD/RFC PR, state and scenario matrix, unresolved decisions listed; no UI implementation or approval inferred. Existing tracking: hermit-ixg; audit: hermit-gk7.

tasks.title: B0 — Establish the reviewed upstream baseline
tasks.description: External prerequisite for implementation PRs. Review PR #27 and reconcile with current hashneo/hermit/main. Existing 5e46d06 CI is green; upstream is 7f552c2 as fetched 2026-10-16. Preserve Settings fixes, session Keychain cache and truthful refresh failures. Acceptance: human review outcome, required checks on final head, explicit merge authorization and resulting main SHA recorded. Do not self-merge or call the candidate stable while review remains open. Design documents can proceed meanwhile. Broader macOS scenarios: hermit-5lt. iPad and signing remain separate release gates.

tasks.title: R1 — Design review: core journey and information priorities
tasks.description: Human product/design review of Draft PRD-002 and RFC-008 reconciliation. Decide reviewer-first versus maintainer-first default; approve scope persistence, request/document units, workflow versus merge/lifecycle vocabulary, closed-PR re-review, honest partial coverage, recovery and sync completion criteria. Review normal, empty, stale and failed journeys. Acceptance: named reviewer, artifact revision, decision and unresolved items attached. Only complete on explicit approval of the reviewed scope. Requested changes return to D1 and keep this gate pending.

tasks.title: D2 — Specify queue state and Hermit API support
tasks.description: Map every proposed UI signal to existing Hermit API fields and model behavior. Define stable identity (provider/host/repository/PR), request and document counts, active-label re-review eligibility, workflow action ordering with available timestamps and deterministic ties, freshness and per-account partial coverage. Do not sort globally by PR number or infer assigned-to-me without data. Acceptance: contract/state table and synthetic fixture matrix; identify minimal OpenAPI additions only if needed, compatibility and test plan. Follow ADR-009; any major architectural departure requires a Proposed ADR and human approval before implementation.

tasks.title: D3 — Prototype compact and detached dashboard journeys
tasks.description: Produce reviewable compact and detached wireframes using synthetic data. Order information: saved scope, trustworthy coverage/recovery, next review action and document title, supporting context. Defer server port, published totals and detailed diff metadata to Monitor/library/detail. Show loading, true empty, partial empty, cached/offline, auth recovery, mixed-account and merged-but-active re-review cases. Preserve navigation, Settings access and return-to-queue context. Acceptance: annotated screens and keyboard/VoiceOver flow tied to PRD criteria, with current-layout comparison; no production layout change yet.

tasks.title: R2 — Design review: interaction, states and contract feasibility
tasks.description: Joint human design/engineering review of prototypes and API/state mapping. Walk each core journey and failure scenario at compact and detached sizes. Resolve missing API signals, action labels, ordering/count units, error recovery, accessibility and scope persistence before coding. Acceptance: named reviewers, exact artifact revisions, explicit approved decisions and bounded implementation PR sequence. If contracts cannot support a mockup, revise the mockup or scope instead of fabricating data. Complete only on explicit approval; material later changes reopen a review gate.

tasks.title: P1 — Supporting PR: queue presentation model and deterministic fixtures
tasks.description: First supporting implementation PR: isolate queue transformation and state derivation from SwiftUI rendering. Implement approved stable cross-repository identity, eligibility, ordering and explicit count/freshness units. Add only contract changes approved in D2; keep existing layout. Acceptance: meaningful regressions for duplicate PR numbers across repos, multiple documents per PR, active closed-PR re-review, partial auth and cached refresh failure; fixture-driven previews avoid real credentials. CI green and reviewed PR merged into current main before dependent PRs.

tasks.title: P2 — Supporting PR: trustworthy coverage and targeted recovery
tasks.description: Use approved presentation state to make cached/partial coverage and last successful sync explicit. Distinguish no work from unavailable work, retain useful cached rows, route recovery to the affected account/repository and preserve saved scope. Never automatically replace credentials from another account on the same host. Keep Keychain caching within the running process; no password caching, ACL weakening or persistent token workaround. Acceptance: fixture-driven loading/empty/partial/stale/auth/rate-limit cases and targeted recovery integration checks; reviewed independently and merged with green CI.

tasks.title: P3 — Dashboard PR: review queue hierarchy and progressive detail
tasks.description: Implement the approved compact/detached hierarchy: scope and coverage first, actionable review rows next, diagnostics and catalog browsing through secondary navigation. Make document title and workflow action prominent; move branch/file/diff metadata and excerpts to progressive detail. Apply approved ordering and label request/document counts; explain active re-review separately from merge state. Acceptance: screenshot comparison to R2, keyboard/VoiceOver paths, narrow-window layouts and preserved Settings/Monitor/library access. Keep changes reviewable as one layout PR and preserve a simple revert path.

tasks.title: P4 — Dashboard PR: completion feedback and return to queue
tasks.description: Connect existing supported review actions to truthful submission/pending/success/failure feedback and return-to-queue selection. Confirm canonical GitHub state through the Hermit API before reporting completion or removing work. Preserve scope/selection on refresh and retry; cover delayed sync and failed writes. Acceptance: journey-level checks from queue to document/action to refreshed queue, with no optimistic false success. If required commenting or approval capability is absent, replan a separately approved feature instead of silently expanding this dashboard PR.

tasks.title: O1 — Supporting environment: stable development signing
tasks.description: Existing blocker hermit-oaj. Establish a stable development signing identity with the user so rebuilding Hermit does not replace the Keychain-trusted code identity every time. Current machine has no valid signing identity and ad-hoc builds can reprompt despite Always Allow. Acceptance: identity configured locally and a controlled rebuild/relaunch verifies credential access; document remaining macOS consent behavior. Do not collect passwords, export credentials, weaken Keychain ACLs or repeatedly rebuild just to probe prompts. Synthetic fixtures may proceed while this remains pending.

tasks.title: O2 — Supporting environment: runnable iPad test target
tasks.description: Existing blocker hermit-1ny. Provide an installed compatible simulator runtime or an explicitly configured physical iPad/signing setup. SDK 26.5 exists but prior asset compilation reports supportedRuntimes=[]. Acceptance: app builds, installs and launches on the selected target with fixture data; record OS/device and commands. A successful SDK-only compile does not satisfy runtime validation. Do not remove this gate merely because macOS tests pass.

tasks.title: V1 — Validate the full journey and accessibility across targets
tasks.description: Test the approved journey on compact/detached macOS and iPad with synthetic multi-account/team fixtures before minimal live checks. Cover scope persistence, multiple documents per PR, colliding PR numbers, merged active re-review, true and partial empty, cancellation, cached/offline, rate limits, auth recovery, delayed/failed sync, new and existing Settings windows, keyboard and VoiceOver. Compare task success and time-to-next-action against baseline using R1-approved thresholds; do not invent success measurements. Acceptance: evidence matrix with builds/devices/screenshots, green relevant CI, no unresolved critical failures; update hermit-5lt. A platform scope reduction needs an explicit human decision and revised PRD.

tasks.title: R3 — Design and release review: approve stable-main adoption
tasks.description: Human product/design and engineering review of the V1 evidence against approved PRD, prototypes and actual final diff. Acceptance: usability findings resolved or explicitly accepted with bounded follow-ups, platform coverage documented, exact tested main SHA and rollback commit recorded, documentation reconciled and explicit release approval. Review changed information priorities, trust/error states and completion behavior, not screenshots alone. Do not close from green CI alone; do not auto-merge. This is the final dashboard adoption gate.
